news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Of these new board members, 2 were independent directors. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. 2 independent directors (3 non-independent directors). Non-Executive Director Sangita Parida is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2023. Independent Director Suresh Pillutla was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Standard Shoe Sole and Mould (India) Limited Announces Appointment of Mothe Rani as Chief Financial Officer, Effective December 6, 2025
news.body: Standard Shoe Sole and Mould (India) Limited at its board meeting held on December 6, 2025, approved the appointment of Ms. Mothe Rani as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the Company with effect from December 6, 2025 on the basis of recommendations received from Nomination and Remuneration Committee and Audit Committee of the Company. Ms. Mothe Rani has an experience of more than 3 years in the field of accounts, finance, and taxation. Her expertise includes extensive proficiency in the preparation of financial statements and comprehensive analysis of books of accounts.
